disposition_reason: Table 4 prints zinc, nickel, copper, chromium, iron, cadmium and lead for each of 14 retail milk brands bought in Ankara, with the mean and SD across brands.

study.design: Retail survey and method paper (ETAAS with nickel modifier)
study.method: HNO3 + H2O2 hot-plate digestion of 1.0-1.5 g; FAAS for Zn, Fe, Cu, Cr, Ni; Zeeman ETAAS with Ni matrix modifier for Cd and Pb
lod: Solution LOD Cu 18.4, Fe 71.2, Zn 20.8, Cr 2.1, Ni 2.3 µg/L (FAAS); Cd 1.2, Pb 1.5 µg/L (ETAAS)
study.qa: IAEA-155 whey powder and BCR-CRM-150 milk powder: relative errors below 4% for all certified elements (e.g. Pb 100 vs 104 µg/kg, Cd 16.4 vs 16.0 µg/kg)
